capabilities: List Microsoft To Do tasks by list or by date
Drag a task into a note as a Markdown task line
Insert a task at the cursor with a + button
Mark tasks the active note already contains
Show recently completed tasks and a task's notes
disambiguation: Not a task manager: it only reads Microsoft To Do tasks and inserts them into notes.
extras: Read-only: it never creates, changes or completes tasks in To Do. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for secret storage; the sign-in token is kept per vault and per device, and cached lists stay in local storage. Not affiliated with Microsoft.
motivation: Microsoft To Do itself does not let you drag tasks into other apps, so the drag starts in this panel instead.
problem: Microsoft To Do cannot drag tasks into other apps, and Obsidian gives no view of which To Do tasks a note already contains.

relations.evidence: A sidebar in Obsidian that lists your Microsoft To Do tasks.

requires.name: Microsoft account with Microsoft To Do

summary: Sidebar that lists Microsoft To Do tasks and inserts them into notes as Markdown task lines by drag or button.
